These vary by location.  3 extra float days after 3 years of work.  One month off, fully paid sabbatical every 5 years of work, in addition to your Paid Time Off days.  Full catalogue of learning modules that cover a wide range of categories for personal and professional development  Discount on Pet Insurance and a variety of other non-travel perks and discounts  Working Holidays: Ability to work from any of our 23 global offices for a short period of time    DE & I Statement  Widespread acceptance for every person. vagas.title: Product Manager: Payments Mandates & Regulatory Readiness
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Product Manager: Payments Mandates & Regulatory Readiness em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Product Manager: Payments Mandates & Regulatory Readiness At EBANX , we believe barriers were made to be broken. We started our story in Curitiba, Brazil, and today we are a global company present in more than 29 countries, with offices in Curitiba, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Johannesburg . In total, we are 700+ ebankers  spread across the world, connecting companies like Uber, Netflix, Spotify, TikTok, Canva, Shopee, Meta, and Shein  to millions of consumers in emerging markets—creating new opportunities and revolutionizing the future of digital payments. Our mission is clear: to give global access to everyone . We are guided by the motto #TamoJunto , which translates into four key pillars: Shape Tomorrow, Evolve Fast, Make It Happen, and Unlock The World.  If you want to be part of a global company with accelerated growth that is shaping the future of digital payments, EBANX is the place for you. At EBANX’s Product team you don’t just create features. You develop user-centered solutions that transform the experience of millions of consumers and global companies. Every product decision you make has a real impact on the future of digital payments, combining strategic vision, innovation, and collaboration to make our work truly Out Of The Ordinary . As a Product Manager for Payments Mandates & Regulatory Readiness, your mission will be to build and lead EBANX’s strategy for scheme and regulatory compliance. You will be responsible for creating a unified product-owned governance model that ensures readiness, visibility, and proactive execution of all Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and regulatory requirements that impact our payments capabilities. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and our global merchant base, playing a critical part in enabling EBANX to scale safely, maintain performance, unlock new features, and operate with predictability in fast-evolving markets. Define the vision, framework, and processes for mandates and regulatory readiness across all markets; Build a centralized governance model that brings structure, visibility, and ownership to scheme and regulatory requirements; Partner cross-functionally with engineering, compliance, legal, ops, and country teams to assess impact, scope solutions, and ensure on-time delivery; Track the evolving landscape of scheme mandates, regulatory changes, and technical requirements, anticipating their implications for EBANX; Prioritize mandates and compliance initiatives based on risk, business impact, and market strategy; Manage the full lifecycle of each mandate, from understanding requirements, to defining product impact, to coordinating implementation and ensuring readiness ahead of deadlines; Guarantee clear communication, documentation, and alignment across teams, enabling predictable execution and reducing operational risk; Act as the internal expert on scheme and regulatory evolution, supporting strategic decisions and shaping future product capabilities.  Must-haves to shine in this role:  Proven experience in product management, payments, regulatory compliance, or fintech infrastructure; Strong understanding of the global payment ecosystem, scheme rules (Visa/Mastercard/Amex), and regulatory frameworks; Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulatory or scheme requirements and translate them into product impact; Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing cross-functional teams and senior leadership; Experience working in agile environments and leading multi-team initiatives under tight deadlines; Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguity, build processes from scratch, and drive predictable execution in complex contexts.  Bonus points if you have:  Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth companies or global fintechs; Multicultural experience collaborating across countries and teams; A passion for simplifying complexity, building governance models, and creating long-term strategic foundations; Knowledge of scheme mandates, regulatory landscapes, or compliance-related product work; A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to anticipate risks and connect details to strategic outcomes.  EBANX offers:  Performance Bonus:  Annual bonus program based on company results. EBANX Education:  Financial assistance for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs to support your professional growth. EBANX Skills:  Dedicated budget for courses, certifications, and workshops to encourage continuous learning. Language Classes:  Language classes to support your personal and professional development. Health & Well-being:  Medical and dental plans with extensive coverage, including support for dependents and wellness programs. Flexible Work Culture:  Semi-flexible hours, additional day off on your birthday, and year-end break to support work-life balance. Well-being Program:  Access to activities and resources that promote physical and mental health.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Descrição  Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Segurança da Informação para liderar a evolução da arquitetura de segurança corporativa, atuando como elo estratégico entre tecnologia, negócios e conformidade. Essa posição é chave para garantir que nossas soluções estejam alinhadas com os mais altos padrões de segurança, inovação e governança.  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Desenhar e evoluir a arquitetura de segurança corporativa, alinhada às estratégias de negócio, gestão de riscos e requisitos regulatórios.  Avaliar e aprovar projetos tecnológicos, assegurando conformidade com frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, OWASP.  Atuar como parceiro estratégico de arquitetura de TI e engenharia de software, orientando sobre segurança em aplicações, APIs, ambientes Cloud e soluções com IA generativa.  Realizar análises de risco em novas soluções e integrações, com foco em mitigação preventiva e segurança by design.  Definir controles de segurança para modelos de IA, abordando temas como proteção de dados sensíveis, explicabilidade, mitigação de vieses, proteção de propriedade intelectual e conformidade regulatória.  Conduzir revisões técnicas e análises de arquitetura segura em ambientes on-premises e cloud.  Colaborar com áreas de GRC, privacidade e auditoria, traduzindo riscos técnicos em impactos de negócio.  Contribuir na definição e priorização do roadmap de segurança, com base em criticidade, apetite de risco e maturidade tecnológica.    Requisitos e qualificações   Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de segurança e avaliação de riscos tecnológicos.  Conhecimento prático em Cloud Security (AWS, Azure ou GCP), IAM, Network Security, API Security e Data Protection.  Vivência em segurança aplicada à Inteligência Artificial, incluindo LLMs, pipelines de dados e governança de modelos.  Capacidade de identificar e mitigar riscos emergentes (IA, supply chain, Shadow IT, data leakage, etc.).  Domínio de frameworks e metodologias: NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CSA CCM, MITRE ATT&CK, STRIDE, OWASP Top 10.  Habilidade para comunicar riscos técnicos de forma clara e estratégica para diferentes públicos.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Overview  Our Mission: At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.  Who We Are: In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!  We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.  The Team  Sales - The Sales team at Palo Alto Networks is a pivotal group of professionals dedicated to driving the company\'s growth and market leadership. This team is responsible for selling our comprehensive cybersecurity portfolio, including next-generation firewalls, cloud security, and endpoint protection, to a diverse range of customers, from small businesses to the world\'s largest enterprises. They build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understand their unique security challenges, and architect solutions that protect their digital way of life. Our sales organization is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where strategic thinking, deep product knowledge, and a passion for solving complex problems are paramount. The team works collaboratively with systems engineers, channel partners, and other internal stakeholders to deliver exceptional value and ensure customer success. We are looking for driven, results-oriented individuals who are eager to make an impact in the rapidly evolving world of cybersecurity.  Job Summary  We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Cortex and Cloud business. The ideal candidate will operate in a high-growth environment, have a solid background in cybersecurity sales, and a deep understanding of security solutions. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.  Key Responsibilities   Build and cultivate strong customer relationships to drive business growth within the assigned region.  Proactively collaborate with the core sales team to align customer strategies and engagements with Cortex and Cloud business objectives.  Take full ownership of leading strategic sales campaigns and sales forecasting, utilizing in-depth knowledge of complex sales cycles.  Translate complex technical cybersecurity solutions into clear business value propositions for customers during deep technical discussions.  Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including sales engineers, to provide tailored, customer-centric solutions.  Partner with Alliances to develop joint strategies that enhance customer engagement and deliver innovative solutions.  Travel domestically as needed to meet with customers and support key business initiatives.    Required Qualifications  Qualifications (Additional Job Description)   5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to Enterprise or Major-level accounts.  Extensive platform selling experience in complex sales with multiple buying centers.  Experience selling Cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR, or CNAPP (DevSecOps, CloudOps) solutions.  Established trusted relationships with CIOs and CISOs with the ability to influence and drive strategic conversations.  Willingness to travel domestically as necessary to meet business needs.    Preferred Qualifications   Experience working with channel partners and a deep understanding of a channel-centric go-to-market strategy.  Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.  Experience operating in a continuous adoption, expansion, and upsell sales motion within a matrixed sales organization.    Our Commitment  We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. Temos a missão de garantir uma oferta competitiva, inovadora e focada nas necessidades das empresas, cultivando o foco na excelência de atendimento e encantamento dos nossos clientes para gerar resultados. Overview Location:  Remote / Latin America (Preferred) Checker is the global liquidity network for stablecoins. We enable regulated financial institutions—such as banks, Payments Service Providers (PSPs), remittance providers, and FX brokers—to adopt stablecoins and scale their operations globally by plugging into our network. As we scale, we’re looking for an exceptional leader who understands the unique opportunities and challenges of bringing crypto payment solutions to this dynamic market. We are a global-first company. Our core team is based on the East Coast of the U.S., with colleagues in Europe and Asia. We come from trading, treasury, operations, and engineering backgrounds from Wall Street hedge funds, large crypto institutions, and blockchain technology startups. At Checker, our culture drives everything we do. We are true partners to our customers, meeting them where they are. We are at the forefront of fintech, so we approach every challenge with a mindset to “adapt and overcome.” You’ll thrive here if you excel in fast-paced environments and strive to make an impact. The Opportunity We are seeking a Marketing Manager, preferably based in LATAM, to localize and scale our go-to-market across Latin & South America. You’ll be Checker’s first dedicated marketer, collaborating with leadership and sales to grow Checker’s partnerships with scaled crypto apps, neobanks, fintechs, and regional banks. This is a full-stack role: Refine target account lists Shape the narrative for the region Run the mix—events, content, partner marketing, market-specific activations, product marketing and sales collateral, paid campaigns, and PR As we scale from hundreds to thousands of customers, we need someone who can create foundational sales collateral, implementation guides, and customer success stories that turn complex on-chain payment infrastructure into clear, concise value propositions. You’ll operate as an IC at first while building the foundation: Competitive research Localized messaging Playbooks Repeatable programs Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to hire specialized freelancers, agencies, and full-time staff.  What You’ll Do Regional GTM & planning  — Build the LATAM marketing plan tied to pipeline and revenue targets; define objectives, budgets, and quarterly calendars Target account strategy  — Partner with BD leadership to refine ICPs and named account lists; run ABM campaigns and outreach plays by segment (exchanges, neobanks, fintechs, banks) Partner & field marketing  — Design co-marketing with strategic partners (announcements, case studies, webinars, in-person events); equip BD with region-ready plays Localization & product marketing  — Translate and adapt messaging, proof points, one-pagers, pricing narratives, and demos for local buyers; maintain a regional message house Content for the region  — Produce market-specific explainers, regulatory primers, and customer stories that educate enterprise buyers on on-chain payments Events & activations  — Own LATAM event strategy (flagship conferences, roadshows, private roundtables); drive pre-/during-/post-event programs and measurable ROI Comms & PR  — Coordinate regional PR and earned moments with HQ comms and agencies Enablement  — Build regional sales decks, talk tracks, objection handling, and case studies Agency & vendor management  — Source and manage regional specialists (events, creative, PR, translators, etc.)  What We’re Looking For 7–10 years in B2B marketing, with meaningful experience in LATAM fintech, payments, or adjacent infrastructure Comfortable starting from first principles, creating clarity, and shipping programs solo before scaling Strong grasp of ABM and how marketing fuels enterprise deals; able to set KPIs and own outcomes Ability to translate technical concepts (stablecoins, on-chain payments, APIs, compliance) into clear value for executives and product leaders Full professional proficiency in Spanish; Portuguese strongly preferred Strong written skills for localization Practical fluency with CRM and marketing automation tools, analytics, and AI-driven content or translation workflows Based in LATAM (or ability to frequently travel to the region) Willing to travel: 25–40% for partners and events  What We Offer Competitive compensation Flexible remote work arrangement Travel to global team gatherings and industry events  We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Sr. Business Development Specialist - Transaction Execution (Position based in Saudi Arabia)
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Sr. Business Development Specialist - Transaction Execution (Position based in Saudi Arabia) em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent, expat position.  Overview We are seeking a Business Development Specialist who has a background in Transaction Execution to join the Divestment Department. The Divestment department is responsible for optimizing the corporate portfolio through the strategic divestment of assets and securing specialized partners to manage the assets in the future. Operating under the corporate development mandate, this function is responsible to lead the end-to-end execution of complex divestment transactions, from identifying optimization opportunities to sourcing world-class partners and negotiation high-value exists. Your primary role is to lead complex transactions, often valued at $500MM or larger. Key Responsibilities You will be required to perform the following: Implement the company's portfolio optimization strategy by identifying, screening, and evaluating assets for potential divestment. Leads the development of the Investment Memorandum and overall transaction strategy for each divestment, including: valuation, structuring, and defining key value levers. Leads the entire divestment process, ensuring robust analysis and adherence to the corporate stage-gate process to secure internal approvals. Support the negotiation of key commercial terms and definitive agreements. Development of negotiation strategies, aiming to optimize commercial terms and mitigate risk. Scrutinize and contribute to the drafting and analysis of all commercial and legal documentation, including: Sale and Purchase Agreements (SPAs), Transition Services Agreements (TSAs), Head of Terms, and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs). Drives consensus and coordinates with senior internal stakeholders (e.g., Law, Finance, Strategy, HR) to ensure seamless deal alignment and progression. Prepares and delivers high-impact briefings, analyses, and recommendations to corporate committees and executive management to secure mandate and transaction approvals. Acts as the central liaison for all transaction-related activities, ensuring clear communication and efficient resolution of complex issues. Provides administrative direction to Business Development staff including job performance appraisals, job promotion recommendations, and relevant human resources development roles. Represents Saudi Aramco, its affiliates, and/or the Kingdom in professional societies, committees and conferences. Actively guide and develop junior team members, providing hands-on technical coaching, constructive performance feedback, and mentoring. Support and foster a high-performing team by sharing expert knowledge and best practices learned from live transactions and prior experience.  As a successful candidate you hold a: Bachelor degree in Engineering, Business and Management or related discipline from an accredited university. Advanced degree is a plus. Minimum of 12 years of experience in corporate development: transaction end to end deal management, portfolio strategy and optimization, commercial structuring, negotiation, carve-out planning, corporate finance and valuation Professional certifications such as: Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus. Industry expertise and knowledge of specific business transaction and venturing activities, such as: operational or financial carve out, commercialization, joint venture development and management, project development and execution, valuation and economic/financial modeling, business operations and maintenance, and strategy development and execution. Expertise in financial analysis or companies and transaction valuation. Focused knowledge and experience in one or more of the following; carve-out divestment, financial re-structuring, or initial public offering (IPO). Must have advanced English verbal and written skills. You are willing and able to relocate to Saudi Arabia.  Aramco energizes the world economy.  Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply. We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Business Development Analyst, Simplic (Hybrid)  Overview  Enova Overview Enova International (NYSE: ENVA) is a leading provider of online financial services for non-prime consumers and small businesses. With annual revenue of nearly $2 billion, we leverage advanced technology and analytics to serve millions of customers across the U.S. and Brazil. In Brazil, we operate as Simplic, offering 100% online personal loans with fast, flexible, and convenient access to credit. We combine the agility of a fast-growing startup with the stability of a large corporation, and we value smart, driven people who bring fresh, innovative ideas to the table.  About the Role  We’re looking for a Business Development Analyst who is curious, analytical, and action-oriented. You will identify market opportunities, shape product strategy, and translate insights into clear business cases and recommendations. The role combines market monitoring, product improvement, new product ideation, financial projections, and executive-ready storytelling to support decision-making and growth. In this role you will:   Monitoring market trends, competitive moves, and customer insights to identify opportunities and risks  Proposing improvements to existing products (e.g., pricing, features, funnels) and defining hypotheses, experiments, and KPIs  Scoping and proposing new products/partnerships, including go-to-market plans and pilot designs  Building managerial projections and scenario analyses (revenue, unit economics, volume) and maintaining concise performance dashboards  Preparing and delivering executive-ready presentations for leadership, with clear narratives, options, and recommendations  Build and cultivate relationships with cross-functional teams within the organization  Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, Marketing and Operations to align roadmaps, timelines, and impact tracking    We’re excited about you   Are a demonstrated self-starter and problem solver - You’ll be successful in this role if you can think critically and dig deeper to improve processes and campaign performance  Have strong analytical skills - Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make actionable recommendations.  Are creative and think outside the box - The only constant in our industry is change. You love to brainstorm, generate new ideas, and bring creative, innovative solutions to the challenges our customers face every day.    Requirements   Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration or related fields. Our team comes from a variety of backgrounds but are successful because of their ability to problem solve and think analytically  Demonstrate strong analytical thinking through excellent written and oral communication skills  Experience in Customer Service planning / optimization  Strong proficiency in both English and Portuguese (spoken and written).  Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Basic knowledge of SQL (or willingness to learn)  Our hybrid roles require in-office work Tuesday through Thursday, with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays. This schedule fosters collaboration, team connection, and strategic planning, enhancing communication and effectiveness to drive results.  Health, dental, and vision insurance including mental health benefits  401(k) matching plus a roth option (U.S. Based employees only)  PTO & paid holidays off  Sabbatical program (for eligible roles)  Summer hours (for eligible roles)  Paid parental leave  DEI groups (B.L.A.C.K. @ Enova, HOLA @ Enova, Women @ Enova, Pride @ Enova, South Asians @ Enova, APEX @ Enova, and Parents @ Enova)  Employee recognition and rewards program  Charitable matching and a paid volunteer day…Plus so much more!    About Enova  Enova International is a leading financial technology company that provides online financial services through our AI and machine learning-powered Colossusplatform. We serve non-prime consumers and businesses alike, while offering world-class technology and services to traditional banks—in order to create accessible credit for millions.  Being a values-driven organization is at the core of Enova’s success. We live our values by listening to our customers, challenging assumptions, thinking big, setting high expectations, and hiring and developing the best. Through our values and our commitment to making Enova an awesome place to work, we maintain an environment of inclusion and culture where our employees can thrive. You can learn more about Enova’s values and culture.  It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all persons and not discriminate in employment decisions by placing the most qualified person in each job, without regard to any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. Why join us TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. Collaboration: Work closely with Logistics, Quality, R&D, and Operations teams to understand failures, propose solutions, and support root cause investigations. Inventory & lab management: Organize and maintain the physical and digital inventory of returned devices and those awaiting disposal, while ensuring the lab remains clean, organized, and fully operational. Continuous improvement: Propose and implement improvements to optimize processes and team routines. Communication: Actively participate in team and department meetings, presenting results and aligning actions with leadership.  Requirements Completed Technical Degree in Electronics. Understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and basic concepts of hardware and firmware. Ability to interpret electronic technical documents (datasheets, schematics, PCB Gerbers) and mechanical documents (2D technical drawings and work instructions). Hands-on experience with measurement and diagnostic instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, etc.). Intermediate English fluency. Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.  Bonus Points Experience with scripting languages such as Python. Basic knowledge of programming languages such as C. Experience with other low-level programming languages. Fluency in English proficiency. Overview Hardware Troubleshooting Technician  role at TRACTIAN  Join to apply for the Hardware Troubleshooting Technician role at TRACTIAN. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features. Why join us TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. At TRACTIAN, you\'ll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech. The Hardware team The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale. What You'll Do As a Hardware Troubleshooting Technician, you will play a key role in analyzing, diagnosing, and resolving failures in our devices, ensuring the reliability and quality of our solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes, document findings, and contribute to continuous improvements in processes and products. Your hands-on expertise with electronics, mechanics, and measurement tools will be essential to deliver effective outcomes. Responsibilities Troubleshoot and diagnose: Perform in-depth analyses of electronic and mechanical devices, identifying failures following detection standards. Acceptance testing: Execute acceptance tests on electronic and mechanical devices. Documentation: Record written and photographic evidence, document occurrences in specialized software, and maintain detailed reports. Collaboration: Work closely with Logistics, Quality, R&D, and Operations teams to understand failures, propose solutions, and support root cause investigations. Inventory & lab management: Organize and maintain the physical and digital inventory of returned devices and those awaiting disposal, while ensuring the lab remains clean, organized, and fully operational. Continuous improvement: Propose and implement improvements to optimize processes and team routines. Technical expertise: Operate instruments such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, and other diagnostic tools. Communication: Actively participate in team and department meetings, presenting results and aligning actions with leadership.  Requirements Completed Technical Degree in Electronics. Proven professional experience in electronics troubleshooting, repair, or related areas. Enrollment in a Bachelor\'s degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Knowledge of electronic circuits, components, and schematic reading. Understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and basic concepts of hardware and firmware. Ability to interpret electronic technical documents (datasheets, schematics, PCB Gerbers) and mechanical documents (2D technical drawings and work instructions). Hands-on experience with measurement and diagnostic instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, etc.). Intermediate English fluency. Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.  Bonus Points Experience with scripting languages such as Python. Basic knowledge of programming languages such as C. Experience with other low-level programming languages. Fluency in English proficiency. vagas.title: CAE Engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para CAE Engineer em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Why join us TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech. As a CAE Engineer at Tractian, you'll drive the innovation and development of our IIoT solutions. Collaborating across teams, you'll apply your expertise in mechanics and design to create high-performance products that redefine industrial asset management. From concept to execution, your role will shape Tractian's industry-leading technology, ensuring top-tier quality and functionality in every solution we deliver. Responsibilities  Set up and run FEM analyses: linear/nonlinear static, modal transient, random, frequency response, explicit, durability. Analyze vibrational behavior, derive FRFs, and interpret mode shapes to optimize performance. Apply DOE, response surfaces, optimization, and uncertainty analyses to explore design space and quantify risk. Plan and perform tests for model correlation and validation. Partner with test teams on accelerated life testing, translating field data into test requirements and simulation inputs. Script pre/post-processing (Python, MATLAB) to scale studies and improve modeling quality. Document standards, templates, and best practices; propose new methods to capture physics and speed up iteration. Work closely with product development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production teams, guiding decisions with technical data. Deliver clear reports and presentations explaining assumptions, modeling choices, limitations, and design implications.  Requirements  Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related engineering field. Strong understanding of FEM fundamentals, with hands-on experience. Ability to explain model behavior and link results to underlying physics. Experience in test-based model calibration/validation and correlating simulation with experimental data. Knowledge of fatigue analysis and durability assessment. Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for data processing, automation, and custom tool development. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment. Proactive, self-directed learner who goes beyond the brief to resolve issues. Advanced English level. Live in or have availability to move to São Paulo.  Bonus points  Expertise in vibration and structural dynamics. Experience in optimization, robust/stochastic design, and uncertainty quantification. Hands-on experience with FEA pre-processing tools and solvers (e.g., Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, Radioss, HyperMesh/ANSA).  Compensation:  Competitive salary and stock options Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses 30 days of paid annual leave Education and courses stipend Employee Giving Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life. Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities  We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Process Optimization  Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements to reduce project turnaround times by at least 15% . Performance Monitoring & Reporting  Track project performance metrics, maintain 100% accurate documentation  and generate actionable insights for continuous improvement. Budget & Resource Management  Optimize resource allocation to maximize efficiency and reduce costs by at least 10%  per project. Client Success & Retention  Develop strategies to improve customer retention, contributing to a minimum of 90% repeat business  from existing clients. Post-Project Evaluation  Conduct project reviews to capture lessons learned and implement best practices, improving future project success rates by at least 20% . Software/Platforms/Tools:  Project Management:  Asana, Jira, Trello Qualifications:  At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience, ideally in project management within a B2B startup or marketing agency. Strong verbal and written English communication skills for client and team interactions. Experience in risk management, stakeholder coordination, and customer success strategies. Proven ability to analyze project performance and implement improvements to drive efficiency.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica. Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos. Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos. vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Junior Product Owner - Brazil em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About North Star Network  North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.  Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment.  We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.  About the Role  At North Star Network, we are looking for a Junior Product Owner for our Brazilian Business Unit to support our Product team in delivering high-quality, business-driven digital products.  This role is ideal for someone organized, curious, and eager to grow in Product Management, with a strong interest in digital products, user experience, and data-informed decision-making.  You will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Tech, UX, QA, and business stakeholders to help translate business and user needs into clear, actionable product requirements, ensuring smooth delivery and continuous improvement across our platforms.  Key Responsibilities  1. Backlog Management & Specification   Assist in maintaining a structured and organized product backlog.  Draft initial user stories and acceptance criteria based on guidance and documented user or business needs.  Support refinement sessions with Tech, UX, and stakeholders to clarify requirements.  Help assess and communicate feature priorities according to business objectives and constraints.    2. Sprint Preparation & Delivery Support   Support backlog grooming sessions by preparing tickets and ensuring required details are available.  Clarify straightforward questions from the development team, escalating complex topics to the Product Owner or Product Manager.  Help validate completed stories by checking alignment with acceptance criteria.  Flag potential requirement gaps, risks, or dependencies to the Product Owner or Product Manager early.    3. Product Quality & Feedback Loop   Contribute to ensuring user stories lead to high-quality product increments.  Collaborate with QA by supporting test case preparation and helping review defects.  Collect basic user feedback, operational insights, or data points to support iteration.  Uphold consistency in product behavior and user experience by reporting inconsistencies.    4. Stakeholder Communication   Assist in maintaining communication between stakeholders and the development team.  Help prepare status updates, release notes, or documentation for internal stakeholders.  Communicate small updates or clarifications, while escalating major decisions to the Product Owner or Product Manager.  Ensure continuous alignment with the Product Owner and Product Manager on prioritization and scope.    What We’re Looking For   1–3 years of experience in a Product, Project, Business Analyst, or Tech-related role (or relevant internships).  Strong organizational and communication skills.  Ability to structure information clearly and write concise product documentation.  Basic understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies and product development cycles.  Analytical mindset with an interest in data, user behavior, and business impact.  Comfortable working with cross‑functional, fully remote teams.  Fluency in English (written and spoken); French or other languages are a plus.  Interest in digital media, sports, or iGaming is a strong advantage.    What We Offer   A hands‑on Product role with strong learning and growth opportunities.  Exposure to international, high‑traffic digital products in sports and betting media.  100% remote work environment with flexible collaboration across time zones.  A multicultural, fast‑growing team passionate about sports, data, and digital innovation.  A culture of autonomy, ownership, and continuous improvement.  Competitive salary.    Ready to Join Us?  If you’re eager to grow in Product Management, enjoy working at the intersection of business, tech, and user experience, and want to contribute to impactful digital products we’d love to hear from you.  Apply now and help shape the next generation of NSN’s products.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

The Team  Our GTM Enablement team plays a critical role in helping Datadog’s Sales and Customer Success teams succeed by equipping them with the right skills, knowledge, and tools at the right time. We partner closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Curriculum, and Operations to ensure enablement programs translate into real performance in the field.  As Datadog continues to invest in LATAM, this role represents a foundational hire—helping establish how enablement shows up locally while staying tightly connected to our global enablement ecosystem.  The Opportunity  Datadog is growing quickly across Latin America, and we’re looking for our first Field Enablement Manager based in LATAM  to support this momentum. This role will be responsible for delivering ongoing ramp and everboarding enablement  for our Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM—particularly for sellers and CSMs based in Brazil and Mexico .  In addition, you’ll support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America  (e.g., Boston, Denver, Atlanta) who sell into LATAM accounts. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to the field, ensuring global enablement programs land effectively in the local context—across language, culture, sales motion, and market dynamics.  This role is ideal for someone who thrives as an independent operator, builds strong relationships in the field, and enjoys adapting enablement to meet regional needs while staying aligned with global standards. This role will report into the our global Field Enablement team based in New York City and continue partnering with Field Enablement Managers globally across all regions and segments.  What You’ll Do   Deliver live and virtual enablement sessions focused on ongoing ramp and everboarding  for Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM.  Partner closely with Sales and CS leaders in Brazil and Mexico  to understand performance needs and provide targeted enablement support.  Support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America who sell to LATAM customers.  Adapt and localize globally developed enablement programs to ensure relevance across language, culture, market context, and regional sales motions .  Design and facilitate reinforcement activities (e.g., role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that help sellers apply core concepts in real customer scenarios.  Collaborate closely with the Curriculum team  to share field insights, provide feedback on program effectiveness, and support continuous improvement of global content.  Track participation, collect feedback, and use qualitative and quantitative insights to assess enablement impact and identify opportunities for improvement.  Build trusted relationships with Sales, Customer Success, and cross‑functional partners to diagnose challenges and recommend appropriate enablement interventions.  Act as a regional connector—surfacing LATAM‑specific insights back to global enablement teams to help shape future programs.    Who You Are   3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role.  Experience supporting Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment; regional or international experience is a strong plus.  Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, and English  (required).  Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions.  Solid business acumen and comfort working with performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions.  Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented—you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross‑functional partners.  Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDICC or Command of the Message.  Foundational understanding of Datadog’s core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer value.  Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-growing region.  Scrappy and pragmatic—you enjoy building from the ground up and iterating as you go.  Willing and able to travel approximately 30%  across Latin America and North America.    Why This Role Matters  As Datadog’s first Field Enablement hire in LATAM, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how enablement supports our sellers and Customer Success teams in the region. You’ll help ensure our global programs translate into local impact—accelerating ramp, improving confidence, and enabling teams to succeed with customers across a rapidly growing market. Job description Sobre a Rodobens:  Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles. Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade. Por que a Rodobens?  Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil. Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor. A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação  Consórcio  A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais. Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor. Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade! Se você já possui experiência na área ou deseja desenvolver sua carreira em um dos segmentos mais tradicionais e estratégicos da Rodobens, esta é a oportunidade ideal para se conectar conosco. Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará em nosso radar para futuras posições alinhadas às suas competências e ao seu potencial de crescimento. Buscamos pessoas que desejam contribuir para soluções financeiras capazes de transformar vidas e apoiar clientes na realização de seus projetos. Se você quer construir sua trajetória conosco e fazer parte de uma empresa referência no mercado de consórcios, cadastre seu currículo  e participe do nosso Banco de Talentos. Additional information    Local de trabalho:  Nossas oportunidades estão distribuídas em todas as regiões do Brasil!   Benefícios pra você!  VR ou VA Vale transporte Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Auxílio farmácia Descontos especiais em produtos comercializados pela Rodobens e parceiros credenciados Cursos e treinamentos em várias competências na Universidade Rodobens Seguro de vida em grupo Sessões de psicoterapia PPR Programa de Saúde Financeira – Super Rico Wellhub (antigo Gympass) Clube de Vantagens Rodobens: Descontos especiais em produtos e serviços. A Capco  é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 40 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira! Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) com perfil prático (hands-on) que projeta e entrega um padrão de “hub de dados” no Microsoft Fabric para conectar e integrar dados entre múltiplos workspaces (ex.: marketing → capacitação de vendas), realizar a curadoria desses dados em um Lakehouse e publicar modelos semânticos que suportem relatórios no Power BI — especialmente para dados semiestruturados e não estruturados. Requisitos:  Microsoft Fabric Workspaces  (segurança/papéis, organização por domínios) OneLake + shortcuts  (vinculação de dados entre workspaces sem duplicação) Fabric Lakehouse  (tabelas Delta, padrões de medallion, camadas de curadoria) Notebooks do Fabric  (PySpark + Spark SQL) para transformação, enriquecimento e junções de dados Pipelines (orquestração, agendamento e monitoramento) Dataflows Gen2 (ingestão e transformação low-code) Modelos semânticos do Power BI  (Direct Lake quando aplicável) + conceitos fundamentais de modelagem no Power BI Inglês avançado/fluente  Processamento de dados não estruturados e semiestruturados  (parsing de JSON/texto, extração de metadados, engenharia básica de features de NLP) Modelagem de dados  (esquema estrela, dimensões conformadas, definição de métricas alinhadas a casos de uso de Vendas) Fundamentos de DAX  (medidas, modelagem com foco em performance para relatórios) Governança e padrões de acesso  (princípio do menor privilégio, estratégia de compartilhamento entre workspaces, consciência de linhagem de dados) CI/CD no Fabric  (integração com Git e pipelines de implantação) Otimização de performance  (estratégias de tamanho/particionamento de arquivos, padrões de otimização de tabelas, estratégias de refresh) Certificações:  NaCapco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupo de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros. Nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas para todos(as)!#LifeAtCapco  Se você está ansioso(a) para progredir sua carreira conosco, candidate-se e aguarde o contato de um de nossos recrutadores!    #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Digital Media Manager - Retail
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Digital Media Manager - Retail em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A Vestacy é uma empresa independente (originada do carve-out da Reckitt) com um propósito claro: transformar casas em lares. Somos responsáveis por um portfólio de marcas reconhecidas e confiáveis do mundo (SBP, Mortein, BomAr, Poliflor, Repelex, Woolite, Calgon e Cillit Bang), ajudando milhões de pessoas a cuidar dos espaços onde vivem todos os dias. Como parte do portfólio da Advent, uma das principais empresas globais de private equity, temos autonomia para inovar e acelerar nosso crescimento. Com quase 3.000 colaboradores em mais de 20 países, vemos cada pessoa como um Fundador, com poder para tomar decisões importantes e moldar o futuro. Cuidamos do nosso negócio com a mesma dedicação que você tem pelo seu lar: com propósito, paixão e energia. Aqui, você encontrará espaço para liderar e inovar. Juntos, estamos construindo algo extraordinário. A equipe de Digital Activation Hub da Vestacy é altamente especializada e dinâmica, atuando para conectar a estratégia de marketing à execução nas plataformas digitais. Estamos empenhados em impulsionar cada vez mais a inovação digital das nossas marcas, utilizando nossa expertise para garantir campanhas de alta performance. Sobre a oportunidade Nesta posição como Gerente de Retail Media, você atuará em estratégias para impulsionar a presença digital das nossas marcas em plataformas estratégicas como Amazon Ads, Mercado Livre (Mercado Ads), Google Ads, entre outros. Além disso, você irá colaborar com stakeholders internos e agências parceiras para garantir que nossas campanhas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, planejando ativações de Retail Media de forma estratégica e executando com excelência. Esta posição abrange tanto estratégia quanto execução, abarcando desde o planejamento de ativações de mídia digital até a construção de campanhas em tempo real para maximizar resultados para as marcas e o negócio. Se você gosta de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, orientado(a) a dados e é apaixonado(a) por inovação em retail media no mercado de consumo massivo, queremos te conhecer! Suas responsabilidades: Planejamento estratégico e tático (30% do papel) Transformar insights de marca e audiência em planos de táticos de retail media e paid search, alinhados aos objetivos da campanha e às capacidades das plataformas. Desenvolver calendários mensais e trimestrais de ativação, considerando períodos promocionais, lançamentos de produtos e eventos específicos de cada varejista. Contribuir para a criação e atualização de guias de plataforma, incorporando aprendizados, melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades. Apoiar na definição e distribuição de orçamento para otimizar investimento por plataforma, produto e período.  Execução e otimização (70% do papel) Gerenciar a execução end-to-end de campanhas em Retail Media (Search & Display) e Paid Search (Google Ads, Meta), garantindo lançamentos no prazo e configurações corretas. Monitorar diariamente a performance das campanhas, ajustando em tempo real para melhorar eficiência e atingir os KPIs. Implementar melhores práticas de cada plataforma em segmentação, lançamentos e formatos criativos. Explorar ferramentas e betas para aumentar a efetividade e manter-se atualizado(a) nas tendências de retail media. Coordenar com times internos (marca, analytics, finanças) e com agências parceiras externas para alinhar execução com objetivos de marketing. Realizar testes A/B e pilotos para identificar táticas escaláveis e melhorar produtividade. Reportar métricas-chave (ROAS, conversão, share of voice) e gerar insights.  Estamos em busca das seguintes vivências: Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Publicidade, Comunicação Social e afins; Experiência sólida na gestão de campanhas em plataformas como Amazon Ads e Mercado Livre, Google Ads, etc. Conhecimento profundo em retail media, KPIs (ROAS, conversão, share of voice) e otimização de campanhas. Capacidade de analisar e interpretar dados/KPIs para transformá-los em decisões estratégicas. Vivência com definição estratégias de retail media, incluindo calendários sazonais, alinhamento promocional e segmentação de audiência. Experiência colaborando com times multifuncionais (marca, vendas, analytics) e agências externas. Domínio de ferramentas como DSPs, dashboards analíticos, Excel e PowerPoint. Adaptabilidade e curiosidade: interesse em se manter atualizado sobre tendências e novidades em retail media. Inglês avançado para conexão com times regionais e globais.  Outras informações: - Modelo híbrido (3x2); Com a inclusão no centro de tudo o que fazemos, acreditamos que as melhores equipes são construídas como grandes lares: com bases sólidas e espaço para crescer. Se você se identifica com nosso propósito, te encorajamos a se candidatar em nossas oportunidades, mesmo que você não atenda a todos os requisitos. Todos os candidatos serão avaliados independentemente de idade, habilidades, origem, identidade ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei. Juntos, criaremos um espaço onde todos possam crescer. Disclaimer: a Vestacy não realiza cobranças para a participação em processos seletivos. Caso receba alguma mensagem solicitando pagamento, não responda e entre em contato conosco através das redes sociais ou SAC. Seguindo a política de direitos humanos, não contratamos menores de 18 anos para essa função.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Logistics Partnership Representative
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Logistics Partnership Representative em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Company Overview If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey. We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay). To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more. Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results. Team Overview From day one, you'll be part of a collaborative, global culture where your work directly influences the company’s strategy and growth. As a member of the Logistics Business Unit sales team, you’ll have a great opportunity to design and implement initiatives across all Brazil's market and continuously enhance customer online and offline experience thru our product and operations. The Logistic's BU 99Entrega helps individuals and businesses to solve their daily challenges of moving goods, making their life better everyday. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of analytical thinking & inter-personal ability to build relationships and manage stakeholders. 99Entrega is our last mile delivery service, using cars, motos, utilitaries, vans and small trucks. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment! Being part of this team is a unique opportunity to help build and grow a solid business inside 99 almost from scratch, leaving your own stamp and legacy on the lives of millions of people that will be using our services frequently. Role Responsibilities Como Logistics Partnership Representative, sua missão é atuar em conjunto aos OLs para atingir as metas comerciais da área e garantir que o dia-a-dia com o Operador Logístico (OL) aconteça sem atritos. Você acompanhará de perto os indicadores, ajudará o parceiro na execução dos planos de ação e será o principal responsável por garantir que a teoria do planejamento se transforme em prática na ponta. Acompanhamento e Suporte à Performance Atuar como gestor de conta consultivo para os donos e diretores dos OLs, influenciando a tomada de decisão baseada em eficiência e rentabilidade. Apoiar na prospecção e gestão de OLs parceiros e na condução de rituais de vendas, preparando as bases de dados e apresentações de resultados. Monitorar diariamente os KPIs (nível de serviço, devoluções, produtividade) e alertar o parceiro sobre desvios imediatos. Auxiliar o OL na implementação de melhorias operacionais e processos definidos pela companhia. Garantir o cumprimento da escala e o planejamento de capacidade diária da carteira. Realizar visitas frequentes aos pontos de operação para auditar processos e garantir conformidade com nossos padrões. Atuar na resolução de problemas críticos do dia a dia (conflitos de carga, problemas em aplicativos, gargalos de saída). Alimentar dashboards e realizar consultas básicas em SQL para gerar relatórios de acompanhamento. Identificar padrões simples de falha e sugerir ajustes imediatos ao parceiro.  Role Qualifications Experiência: Experiência em operações logísticas (Last Mile, Transmissão ou Transportes) ou gestão de redes de franquias/parcerias. Perfil Analítico: Excel/Google Sheets intermediário (vlookup/procv e tabelas dinâmicas). Conhecimento de SQL é um grande diferencial Comunicação Assertiva: Precisa saber cobrar o parceiro de forma educada e técnica. Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e suas funcionalidades.  EEO Statement We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient. We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics. We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do. We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow. We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.  Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today. We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys. This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come. We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD). vagas.title: Sr Staff Engineer, Backend - Core Services
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Sr Staff Engineer, Backend - Core Services em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role As a Sr. Staff Software Engineer in Core Services, you are a technical anchor for the foundational systems that power every Uber trip, delivery, and transaction globally. Your scope extends beyond a single team; you will define the 2-3 year technical vision for Uber’s backend ecosystem. You will be responsible for the health, scalability, and evolution of our most critical infrastructure—Identity, Payments, and Safety—ensuring they remain resilient as we scale to the next 100 million users. You will act as a peer to Directors and VPs, providing the technical grounding for Uber's most ambitious business goals. What You'll Do Define the North Star: Lead the creation of a multi-year technical roadmap for Core Services, ensuring our architecture handles 10x growth while reducing systemic complexity. Architectural Governance: Serve as a key member of the Architecture Review Board, setting standards for how backend services are built, deployed, and interconnected company-wide. Buy vs. Build: Lead high-stakes evaluations for foundational technologies (databases, orchestration, messaging) that have long-term financial and operational impact.  Systems Transformation & Excellence Solve the "Impossible": Directly tackle the most ambiguous, high-risk technical challenges that represent significant single points of failure for the company. Institutionalize Reliability: Drive a company-wide shift toward "Zero-Trust" and "Always-On" architectures, re-engineering the platform to make entire classes of failures impossible. Efficiency at Scale: Lead initiatives to optimize infrastructure spend and resource utilization across tens of thousands of nodes without compromising performance.  Cross-Functional & Industry Influence Strategic Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership (VP/CTO level), translating complex technical trade-offs into business risks and opportunities. Ecosystem Leadership: Represent Uber in the broader tech community (open source, conferences, standards bodies), positioning Uber's engineering as an industry gold standard. Culture Carrier: Champion quality and long-term thinking, modeling Uber’s core values of "Go Get It" and "Build with Heart."  Mentorship of Leaders Leader of Leaders: Focus mentorship on Staff Engineers and Engineering Managers, helping them grow into organizational leaders and strategic thinkers. Sponsor Excellence: Identify and sponsor high-potential talent, ensuring a diverse and robust pipeline of future technical leaders.  Minimum Qualifications 15+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of delivering massive-scale distributed systems. History of Org-Wide Impact: Demonstrated ability to lead technical transformations that affect hundreds of engineers and multiple business units. Deep Mastery of Distributed Theory: Expert-level understanding of CAP theorem trade-offs, consensus algorithms (Paxos/Raft), and global data consistency models. Exceptional Communication: Ability to explain deep technical concepts to non-technical executives and build consensus across conflicting organizational priorities.  Preferred Qualifications Open Source Contribution: Significant contributions to major open-source projects in the infrastructure or distributed systems space. Vertical Expertise: Deep experience in FinTech (Payments) or Identity/Security at a global "Big Tech" scale. Future-Proofing: Experience migrating monolithic architectures to highly modular, cell-based, or serverless paradigms at scale.  Uber's mission is to reimagine the way the world moves for the better. Here, bold ideas create real-world impact, challenges drive growth, and speed fuelds progress. What moves us, moves the world - let’s move it forward, together. Offices continue to be central to collaboration and Uber’s cultural identity. Unless formally approved to work fully remotely, Uber expects employees to spend at least half of their work time in their assigned office. For certain roles, such as those based at green-light hubs, employees are expected to be in-office for 100% of their time. Please speak with your recruiter to better understand in-office expectations for this role. *Accommodations may be available based on religious and/or medical conditions, or as required by applicable law. vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Banco de Talentos | Áreas administrativas em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Overview  Não encontrou a vaga que está buscando? Aqui você pode se candidatar para o banco das nossas áreas administrativas .   Comercial   Relações Humanas (RH) - Aqui na teya chamamos de Tê   Financeiro   Tecnologia (TI)   Jurídico     Se você está aqui é porque tem interesse em trabalhar conosco e ficamos muito felizes com isso!  Somos uma organização que gera soluções inovadoras de aprendizagem para pessoas e empresas - queremos promover transformação e atuamos como um ecossistema. Queremos nos conectar com gente boa e boa gente  de diferentes contextos, preferências, formações e com muita história pra contar, enriquecendo muito mais o nosso ecossistema.  Em nosso formato de atuação a nossa proposta é que você trabalhe por projeto (PJ) , com carga horária flexível e tempo determinado. É claro que se fizer sentido para ambos os lados, vamos te incluindo em mais projetos ao longo do tempo.  O que isso quer dizer? Que se você está buscando um trabalho flexível, autônomo e com espaço para criar muita coisa legal, aprender e crescer, se joga na rede .  Como funciona esse nosso banco?   Ao se candidatar você entrará para o nosso banco de talentos. Isso significa que você passará por um processo de seleção mas, pode ser que, em caso de aprovação, a conexão não seja imediata e sim quando novos vagas aparecerem.  Quando as vagas aparecem?   Depende da sazonalidade de vendas de projetos, necessidade de aumento da equipe e/ou necessidade de substituições e, assim que chegam, vamos atrás das pessoas certas para compor as equipes. Por isso, é muito importante termos um banco diverso e atualizado.  Main responsibilities  Qual perfil estamos buscando?    Gente boa e boa gente que gosta de aprender e não se prende em caixinhas.  Pessoas adeptas ao modelo de trabalho por projetos, autônomo e flexível.  Pessoas de diversas regiões do Brasil e do mundo.  Pessoas apaixonadas por aprendizagem e pela oportunidade de realizar projetos transformadores de pessoas e organizações, que já tenham tido experiência neste mercado ou que querem aprender sobre o mundo da aprendizagem corporativa.  Toda experiência e formação que você ache válida. Não é só sobre certificados, queremos conectar pessoas e conhecer histórias    Additional information  Acreditamos que diversidade é essencial para que possamos tornar o nosso ecossistema cada vez mais rico em suas diferenças. Queremos dar oportunidades de carreiras para todas as pessoas que desejem trabalhar conosco. Por isso, esse processo seletivo também é para todas as pessoas que se identificam como parte da comunidade negra, parda e indígena, LGBTQIA+, PCDs e todas as intersecções.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Sobre a MySide  A MySide iniciou sua jornada em 2019, a partir da insatisfação de seus fundadores com a experiência de compra de um imóvel no Brasil. O conceito é simples: enquanto corretores tradicionais trabalham para o vendedor, a MySide se dedica a defender apenas os seus interesses como comprador do imóvel. Por isso, nossa missão é ajudar quem busca um imóvel a fazer a melhor compra.  Se você se identifica com esse propósito e está disposto a crescer conosco, venha fazer parte do nosso time!  Sobre a vaga  Como Corretor de Imóveis você trabalhará com foco exclusivo em atendimento a clientes que estão interessados em comprar imóveis. Na MySide, os corretores são 100% focados em atendimento e não realizam nenhum outro tipo de atividade (geração de leads, captação, venda, etc).  Inspirado no modelo americano de buyer's agent, o método de atendimento MySide é baseado em um relacionamento sólido e de confiança com o cliente, resultando em um alto grau de engajamento.  A nossa abordagem permite que os corretores, ao incorporarem efetivamente nosso método e cultura, alcancem ganhos significativamente superiores à média do mercado.  Buscamos profissionais que estejam dispostos a trabalhar duro e a quebrar paradigmas para aprender uma forma diferente de atuar como corretor imobiliário.  Atualmente em fase de expansão, a MySide já está presente em Goiânia, Belo Horizonte, Curitiba, Balneário Camboriú, Itapema, Balneário Piçarras, Florianópolis e São José.  Requisitos   Boa capacidade de comunicação e leitura de clientes;  Raciocínio lógico apurado. vagas.title: Operador (a) Comercial - Financiamento Veículos Santa Maria - RS Full-time employee
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Operador (a) Comercial - Financiamento Veículos Santa Maria - RS Full-time employee em santa maria. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga  Banco de Talentos – Equipe de Financiamento de Veículos | Região de SANTA MARIA - RS.  Você possui experiência na área de vendas e quer desenvolver sua carreira em um segmento de Financiamento de Veículos? Junte-se ao nosso Banco de Talentos na área de Financiamento e Refinanciamento de Veículos (Leves, Motos e Pesados) na Daycred, parte do Grupo Daycoval, e ajude-nos a alcançar novos patamares de sucesso!  Na Daycred, nosso foco é construir relacionamentos sólidos e oferecer soluções que atendam às expectativas de nossos clientes e parceiros comerciais. Se você busca uma oportunidade em uma equipe que valoriza a proximidade com o cliente, o trabalho em equipe e a excelência em resultados, queremos conhecer você.  Cadastre-se em nosso Banco de Talentos e esteja preparado para fazer parte de uma equipe que impulsiona o mercado de financiamento com inovação e compromisso.  Responsabilidades e atribuições  Como será seu dia a dia:    Vendas externa  Visitas e relacionamento direto com os envolvidos na cadeia de negócios (Gerentes, Vendedores, Administrativos, Diretores e Proprietários de lojas e concessionárias);  Atuação sobre carteira de clientes já existentes no banco, do segmento de veículos (lojas e concessionárias );  Prospecção de novos clientes do segmento (lojas e concessionárias);  Relacionamento com cliente final (consumidor de financiamento).  Participar de treinamentos e reuniões de equipe para aprender sobre novos produtos e serviços, discutir estratégias de vendas e apresentar resultados.  Cumprir metas de vendas: trabalhar para alcançar ou superar as metas de vendas estabelecidas pela empresa, por meio da prospecção de novos clientes e da retenção de clientes existentes.    Requisitos e qualificações  Para ser operador comercial é importante:    Ensino superior completo ou cursando;  Experiência anterior em vendas, atendimento ao cliente ou trabalho com crédito e financiamento.  Experiência no segmento é desejável.  Experiência com carteira de clientes será considerado um diferencial;  Desejável conhecimento sobre o mercado automotivo, modelos de veículos, financiamento e comportamento do consumidor.  Conhecimento de ferramentas de informática básicas, como o Microsoft Office, para manter registros precisos e atualizados dos clientes e dos negócios realizados.  Conhecimento de princípios básicos de finanças, como análise de crédito e cálculo de taxas de juros.  Ter veículo próprio;    Informações adicionais  Na Daycred, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.  Benefícios que Valorizam Você   Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Cobertura após o 3º mês para cuidados médicos e odontológicos de qualidade.  Vale-Refeição/Alimentação  Seguro de Vida  Apoio à Educação: Suporte para desenvolvimento acadêmico e profissional, investindo no seu desenvolvimento.  Parceria com Sesc: Para seu lazer e de seus familiares.    Estamos cheios de desafios, e convidamos você a fazer parte dessa jornada de sucesso, onde #vemserDaycred é mais do que um convite, é um chamado para fazer história.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.  Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.  Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.  Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.  Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.  Estacionamento na sede | Desconto exclusivo para colaboradores.  Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras. At SCIEX, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.  You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.  As part of SCIEX, you will help to influence life changing research and outcomes, while accelerating your potential. For more than 50 years, we have been empowering our customers to solve the most impactful analytical challenges in quantitation and characterization through ground-breaking innovation and outstanding reliability and support. You will be part of a winning team, enabled by DBS, that is passionate about helping life science experts around the world get to answers they can trust.
